resolved_runtime_identity.definition: Hash the exact UTF-8 overlay JSON bytes after replacing only the 64-character self-identity value with 64 ASCII zero characters. This verified value is recorded in formal result and run manifest config_sha256/protocol_sha256 fields; it is not the ordinary complete-file hash and not a separate hash of the fully merged in-memory configuration.

archived_file_byte_level_sha256.definition: Ordinary SHA-256 of the complete stored JSON bytes, including the populated nonzero self-identity field.

hash_semantics.explanation: The two hash pairs are expected to differ because one zeroes the self field to define a stable identity and the other hashes the final bytes containing that identity. This is not a config/protocol mismatch.

resolved_runtime_identity.definition: Self-field-zeroed SHA-256 of the exact UTF-8 overlay JSON bytes: replace only the 64 characters of config_sha256 or protocol_sha256 with 64 ASCII zero characters, then hash. Frozen-V7 verification returns this embedded value; PPO+Progress records it in formal result and run manifest identity fields. It is not the ordinary complete-file hash and not a separate hash of the fully merged in-memory configuration.

archived_file_byte_level_sha256.definition: Ordinary SHA-256 of the complete archived JSON file bytes, including the populated nonzero self-identity field.

hash_semantics.explanation: The hashes differ because the complete-file hash includes the populated self-identity value whereas the runtime identity calculation zeroes that field to avoid self-reference. This is expected by design and is not a configuration or protocol mismatch.
